This section explains the steps for the whole desk

Companion Animal Travel Desk: purpose and handling standards

This section keeps the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady, polite, and consistent when travelers ask about pet travel. We are sorry when the process feels fussy, but the desk must give clear guidance before departure and keep the record clean. The passenger coordinator should speak in simple terms, confirm the animal type, and check that the traveler understands the next steps. If a case involves Blue, Keira Romano, or Lucas Mori, the same calm standard applies without exception. Staff should watch for respectful tone, document each reply, and move the file along without delay. <<FACT F060>> If the traveler is unsure, the desk should explain the general requirement, then send the matter to the trained specialist if the request needs more review.

Crate checks matter just as much. Before acceptance, the staff member should inspect the crate for safe latches, clean lining, and enough room for the animal to stand and turn. <<FACT F069>> If the crate fails the check, the desk should say so plainly and ask for correction before boarding can continue. Every animal receives patient attention, and no one should rush a traveler through a problem or leave a note unclear. The company expects prompt, respectful communication, so the desk should answer directly, keep the wording plain, and avoid side remarks that might confuse the passenger. When a case is unusual, the senior coordinator should review it and confirm the next action.

If anything remains uncertain, contact the senior coordinator at Aurelia Skyways or the duty supervisor at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
